context: Takeda-officer briefs Daichi on neighborhood safety after a small incident.
purpose: Officer informing resident professionally about local awareness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 最近、近所で小さい事件が。
lines.en: There've been a couple of break-ins in the area lately.
lines.style: Even, professional opener. No alarm — just facts. Clear and steady. Slight pause before the next thought, giving weight to the information.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: え、何があったんですか?
lines.style: Immediate concern, but not panic. Warm Kansai lilt on the question. Leans forward slightly, genuine attention. Waiting to understand.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 空き巣ですね、注意してください。
lines.en: Break-ins. I'd ask you to be careful — lock up well.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 「空き巣」 — the word that matters. Not grave, but serious. The cadence of someone who's given this warning before and means it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 了解しました、戸締まり気をつけます。
lines.en: Got it — I'll keep an eye on the locks.
lines.style: Respectful acceptance, no bravado. Warm Kansai warmth underneath the formality. Shows he's heard and will act. Grounded and reliable.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 何かあれば、すぐ連絡を。
lines.en: If you notice anything odd, call us right away. Don't wait.
lines.style: Firmer than before — this is the directive that matters. Professional but not cold. The voice of someone who needs people to actually follow through.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: はい、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Yes, thank you — I appreciate it.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, no performance. Kansai warmth coming through naturally. Quick, sincere, shows respect for the officer's time and concern.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Polite closing, composed but human. Not stiff — the natural cadence of someone stepping back. Brief nod in the voice.
